[LEXP.3.7.4] **An argument outside its domain has no answer.** For a `bits`,
`sign_extend` or `swap_bytes` call whose arguments lie outside the domain
[LEXP.3.7.3] gives, the engine must raise a `ComputationError` of kind `DOMAIN`
([LERR.1.4.1]) and abandon the activation, as it does for a negative shift count
([LEXP.7.14.1]).

The compiler must refuse the call with `DS_VALIDATE_BIT_FIELD_RANGE` when its
compile-time constant arguments ([LEXP.8.8]) place it outside the domain
whatever its other arguments hold: `x.bits(70, w)` and `x.swap_bytes(24)` are
refused, and `x.bits(lo, 8)` with a run-time `lo` is not.
